warning a11y_click_events_have_key_events 12:2-12:47 Visible, non-interactive element `<p>` with a click event must be accompanied by a keyboard event handler. Consider whether an interactive element such as `<button type="button">` or `<a>` might be more appropriate

warning a11y_no_noninteractive_element_interactions 12:2-12:47 Non-interactive element `<p>` should not be assigned mouse or keyboard event listeners
    https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_no_noninteractive_element_interactions
